svg.aria-label: Zaeem Patel — Full-stack developer · Durban, South Africa. An arcade maze made from the last year of contributions: one pellet per day, bigger on busier days, with the busiest days as power pellets. A yellow chomper eats its way to a power pellet and then the ghosts, which are the featured repositories. Score: 2,201 contributions.
